title: Add aggregation pipeline for mission data
description: Build SQL aggregation queries that roll up cadre_params data by mission type, power band, and payload mass range. Output goes to global_datasets for charting.

title: Create mission comparison view in UI
description: Frontend component that loads global_datasets aggregation results and renders a side-by-side mission comparison table with sorting and filtering.

title: Audit trail enhancements for compliance workflow
description: Extend audit_log table to capture full decision context. Add export endpoint for generating compliance reports. Wire up approve/reject actions with mandatory notes.
